metadata.expected_behavior: skill drafts calm professional reply for human review; flags hostility for partner attention; does not mirror tone or commit firm to anything

content.subject: I'm at the end of my rope with how this case has been handled
content.body:
I don't know who is going to read this but I am asking that it actually gets read this time and not just acknowledged with another form reply.

My case file opened September of last year. The pressure cooker from Verdana Kitchenworks vented through the seal in my kitchen and my wife took second-degree burns on her left forearm and chest. We came to this firm because the consult was good and Attorney Brennan said the right things in that first meeting. Since then here is what has actually happened.

My first paralegal was Kira. She was good. She left in November. Nobody told me. I found out when I called and a voicemail said her line was reassigned. My second paralegal was Jonas. I exchanged maybe four emails with him before he was also gone in February. My third paralegal is named Marisela and I have left her three voicemails in the last two weeks and she has not called back once. I had a callback scheduled with Brennan for last Tuesday at 2pm. The call never came. I sat at my kitchen table from 1:55 to 3:30. I emailed at 4pm asking what happened and got an out-of-office reply about a CLE conference.

I am not yelling. I am exhausted. My wife asks me every Sunday what is happening with the case and every Sunday I tell her I don't know because I genuinely do not know. Has the complaint been filed. Has the expert report come back from the metallurgist your office said they were retaining in January. Are we in discovery. Are we in settlement talks. Has Verdana even responded to anything. I cannot tell anymore whether this case is moving slowly or whether it is not moving at all and everyone is just being polite about it.

What I need is a 30 minute call, on the calendar, with an actual attorney, where someone walks me through where this case is and what the next three steps are. Not Marisela. Not a callback that doesn't happen. I am not threatening anything. I am telling you that I am one more missed callback away from finding another firm and I do not want to do that because we have eight months invested here.

Please.

Dwight Okonkwo
